262560|297f06b6.name: Hana Lighthoof
262560|297f06b6.text: Many serve the Earth Mother in different ways. The Earthen Ring and the Cenarion Circle share many similarities and are often aligned in goals, if not methods and customs.

272633|4a619efb.name: Nuara Tremorhoof
272633|4a619efb.text: The ebb and flow of magic has been disrupted, of late. I hear that even the mages of Dalaran are perplexed. Is this disturbance arcane in nature, or are the elements themselves in unrest?
